value.Title: Caribbean Netherlands
value.Description: The Caribbean Netherlands consists of the islands Bonaire, St. Eustatius and Saba.

value.Title: Bonaire
value.Description: Bonaire has had the status of a "special municipality" of the Netherlands since 10 October 2010. On the grounds of this new status as a "special municipality", Bonaire is officially recognised as a public body of the Netherlands.

value.Title: St. Eustatius
value.Description: St. Eustatius has had the status of a "special municipality" of the Netherlands since 10 October 2010. On the grounds of this new status as a "special municipality", St. Eustatius is officially recognised as a public body of the Netherlands.
